During the [[Clone Wars]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] '''stronghold''' was located on<ref name="Dawn" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Anaxes]]. Following the [[Destruction of Anaxes|cataclysmic destruction]] of the planet near<ref name="Dawn" /> the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the war in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the [[mission to Mustafar]], which resulted in the collapse of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], to [[19 BBY]]. As ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' establishes that the [[Separatist holdouts|Separatist holdout]] [[Separatist holdout (PM-6986)|located]] on [[PM-6986]] was founded after the Confederacy's destruction, it must have been founded during or after 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> the stronghold was located on the [[planetoid]] [[PM-6986]] in the [[Anaxes asteroid belt]]. The base housed a [[droid]] [[Separatist holdout (PM-6986)|complement]] that once served within the [[Trench's army|army]] of [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]], and had managed to survive both the battle and the cataclysm. After the planet's destruction, the complement was reactivated by the [[tactical droid]] [[JF-86]], who had previously been reawakened by a Separatist signal that originated [[light-year]]s away.<ref name="Dawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist stronghold was mentioned in ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2018]].<ref name="Dawn" />
